title: toxicodendron grandiflorum var. longipes
intro: Toxicodendron grandiflorum var. longipes, commonly known as Japanese lacquer tree, is a plant species native to Japan, characterized by its distinctive lacquer-like sap. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese lacquer tree include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lacquerin, anacardic acids, and other cardol derivatives, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
